g.title: Verb be (+), subject pronouns
g.rule:
Use am, is, are to say who or what somebody is.

II am Dana. · I'm a student.
he / she / itHe is a teacher. · She's from Astana.
you / we / theyYou are late. · We're friends.
g.ru: Глагол be: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. В разговоре — краткие формы: I'm, he's, we're.

g.title: Verb be (– and ?)
g.rule:
Add not for a negative. Put be first for a question.

negativeI'm not tired. · He isn't here. · They aren't players.
questionAre you a fan? · Is she good?
short answersYes, I am. · No, she isn't.
g.ru: Отрицание: am not, isn't, aren't. В вопросе be ставится перед подлежащим: Are you…? Краткий ответ: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

ex.q: He ___ a footballer. He's a tennis player.
Is it a good team? Yes, it ___.

g.title: Singular and plural nouns
g.rule:
For one thing use a / an. For more than one add -s.

a + consonant · an + vowela pen · an apple
plural + -s / -estwo pens · three boxes · two diaries
irregularman → men · woman → women · child → children · person → people
g.ru: A — перед согласным звуком, an — перед гласным. Множественное число: + -s или -es. Исключения: men, women, children, people.

g.title: Past simple: regular verbs
g.rule:
For a finished past action add -ed.

g.ru: Past simple правильных глаголов: + -ed. Отрицание и вопрос — с did: I didn't check. Did you call?

And?

g.title: Past simple: irregular verbs
g.rule:
Many common verbs have a special past form. Learn them.

common formsgo → went · have → had · get → got · see → saw · buy → bought

questionWhat did you do?
g.ru: Неправильные глаголы имеют особую форму прошедшего времени: went, had, got, saw. После did и didn't — первая форма: didn't go.

There aren't ___ windows in the bathroom.

uncountable: no a / an, no pluralsome rice · some milk · bread

g.title: Quantifiers: how much / how many, a lot of, etc.
g.rule:
Ask and say how much.

How much + uncountableHow much salt do you eat?
How many + pluralHow many eggs do we need?
answersa lot of · quite a lot · not much / not many · none
g.ru: How much — с неисчисляемыми, how many — с множественным числом. Ответы: a lot of, not much, not many, none.

9C.title: Quizzes and quizzers

g.title: Comparative adjectives
g.rule:
Compare two things.

short: + -erold → older · big → bigger · easy → easier
long: moremore difficult · more interesting
irregular · thangood → better · bad → worse · A is bigger than B.
g.ru: Сравнение: короткие прилагательные + -er (older), длинные — more + прилагательное. Good → better, bad → worse. Than — «чем».

Correct. Is a kilometre longer than a mile?

Right. Is gold more expensive than silver?
Yes, it's more expensive.
Good. Last one. Is the Nile longer than the Volga?
Yes, much longer!

g.rule:
Use be going to for a plan.

g.title: Definite article: the or no the

g.ru: The — когда понятно, о чём речь, или предмет один (the sun, the internet). Без the — о вещах вообще: I love music; at home, at work.
